record.minutes: The team reviewed Thursday's inbound volume and agreed to move the after-hours overflow onto the second attendant. Ada took the carrier follow-up, Grace is rewriting the greeting, and the routing change lands before the end of the week. A second pass on the transfer directory was deferred to the next session.
